reply.text: Starting at 78 is a good idea. Strength training is one of the best things an older adult can do, and people begin well into their 80s and 90s. Whether it's safe for you in particular is a question for your doctor, since I'm a coach and can't clear you. It's worth a quick visit before you begin, especially if you have a heart condition, high blood pressure, or take medication. Once you have the go-ahead, we start light, with simple movements, and build slowly. Form comes first, and the weights come second. Want me to set up a beginner program, and how many days a week sounds realistic to you?
